summary: Implemented the window title feature. Changes: rich/segment.py adds SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 and widens ControlCode with Tuple[ControlType, str]; rich/control.py adds the OSC 0 format entry (ESC ] 0 ; title BEL) and the Control.title classmethod, which passes a single (type, text) tuple; rich/console.py adds set_window_title(title) -> bool after set_alt_screen, gated only on is_terminal, with a Google-style docstring; rich/_windows_renderer.py adds an elif branch that calls term.set_title with the title from the second tuple item; CHANGELOG.md gets an Added section under Unreleased with a bullet linking PR 2200. Tests added: test_set_window_title in tests/test_console.py (output assertion skipped on legacy Windows), test_title in tests/test_control.py, and test_control_set_window_title in tests/test_windows_renderer.py (Windows only via existing pytestmark). Not run: tests and mypy were not executed per instructions, so verification is by reading only. Nothing committed.
